description:
Welcome to Chords—a sleek retreat perched on the 5th floor in the heart of Nashville’s West End. This 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo delivers more than just a stay—it offers a front-row seat to the rhythm of Music City. From designer furnishings to sweeping balcony views, every detail is crafted for comfort and style. Step outside and find yourself moments from Midtown’s best eats, iconic landmarks, and Nashville’s legendary energy.

The space
⭐ Building Accommodations & Amenities:
- Premier Midtown location in the heart of Nashville
- Just a 2-minute stroll to beautiful Centennial Park
- Only a 4-minute drive to the bright lights and live music of Broadway
- Private balcony with outdoor seating, perfect for morning coffee or evening unwinding
- Year-round resort-style pool (open 8 am – 8 pm, subject to HOA discretion)
- Communal poolside area featuring a cozy fire pit, BBQ grill, and lounge seating for relaxing and socializing
- State-of-the-art fitness center for your daily workouts
- Smart TVs in the living room and primary bedroom for easy streaming
- In-unit washer & dryer for added convenience during your stay
- Elevator access for smooth, easy movement throughout the building

🛋️ Living Areas:
- Open-floor living areas
- Floor-to-ceiling windows with abundant natural light
- Comfortable designer sofa
- Smart TV
- Stylish décor & thoughtful finishes
- Private balcony with outdoor seating

🍽️ Kitchen & Dining:
- Fully equipped kitchen
- Stainless steel appliances
- Fridge, dishwasher, oven, 4-burner stove, microwave & toaster
- Bar seating for 3 guests
- Kitchen Starter Kit: 2 dishwashing tablets, dish soap, 1 dish sponge, 2 laundry detergent pods, disinfectant wipes, 2 paper towel rolls, 10 trash bags, 1 coffee bag, and 4 coffee filters

🛌 Bedrooms & Bathrooms:
- Primary Bedroom (5th Floor): 1 King bed with smart TV, large walk-in closet, and en-suite bathroom with double vanity, and large walk-in shower
- 2nd Bedroom (5th Floor): 2 Twin beds, jack-and-jill walk-in closet, and jack-n-jill en-suite bathroom with single vanity, and shower/tub combo
*Additional Sleeping: Sleeper sofa in the living room
- Bathroom Starter Kits: 1 shampoo, 1 conditioner, 1 body wash, 1 hand bar soap, 1 makeup wipe, 2 liners for trash can, and 2 rolls of toilet paper

🚗 Parking:
- First-come, first-served parking garage located behind the building

❗️Notes to Guests & Important Details:
- The pool is open year-round, but may close due to extreme weather. Hours of operation are from 8 am to 8 pm.
- This unit is located on the 5th floor, and the building does have an elevator to take you to each floor.
- We offer multiple rooms for this building, each designed to provide a beautiful/comfortable place to stay. While our rooms remain consistent, the layout, size, and design may vary.
- This is an upcoming neighborhood, so there is nearby construction for surrounding buildings. Depending on your length of stay and booking dates, guest may experience nearby construction noise.
- Please note that GNS is not responsible for monitoring the parking garage.
